primitives.name: MembranePotential
primitives.summary: 膜电位时程：静息 → 去极化 → 峰值 → 复极化 → 超极化，标出阈电位与各阶段主导离子（Na⁺ 内流 / K⁺ 外流），波形由参数化函数给出
primitives.signature: ({ s, rest, threshold, peak, onset, dur, undershoot, color, progress, showIons })

primitives.name: IonChannel
primitives.summary: 电压门控离子通道：闸门按 open 开合，离子按开度穿过，标注通道类型与当前开放百分比
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, thick, open, ion, color, progress, seed })

primitives.name: Synapse
primitives.summary: 化学突触：突触前终扣（含囊泡）→ 间隙递质扩散 → 突触后受体结合，release 与 binding 两个进度分开控制
primitives.signature: ({ preX, preY, cleft, release, binding, quanta, color, progress, seed })

primitives.name: Summation
primitives.summary: 突触整合：EPSP/IPSP 按时间与空间求和（指数衰减核），越过阈电位才发放，给出峰值与是否触发结论
primitives.signature: ({ s, inputs: [{amp, at, label, excitatory}], threshold, rest, tau, color, progress })

primitives.name: BrainMap
primitives.summary: 脑侧面轮廓的分区定位图（额叶/顶叶/颞叶/枕叶/小脑/脑干），active 高亮指定脑区
primitives.signature: ({ cx, cy, scale, active, color, progress })

primitives.name: Pathway
primitives.summary: 神经通路：核团节点 + 有向连线，支持在 midpoint 交叉（视交叉的鼻侧纤维交叉）
primitives.signature: ({ nodes: [{x, y, label, color}], edges: [{from, to, label, crossing}], progress, color })

primitives.name: ReceptiveField
primitives.summary: 同心圆拮抗感受野：中心圆 + 环形外周，光斑位置决定响应，右侧给出放电率条与 Hz 数值
primitives.signature: ({ cx, cy, r, spot: {dx, dy, r}, type: 'on'|'off', baseline, gain, color, progress })

primitives.name: Plasticity
primitives.summary: LTP/LTD：相对基线的突触强度曲线，刺激时刻打竖直标记线，末端给出百分比与 LTP/LTD 判定
primitives.signature: ({ s, strength, stimuli, color, progress, label })

primitives.name: MemoryPath
primitives.summary: 记忆形成通路：编码 → 海马 → 巩固 → 皮层 → 提取，带海马到皮层的巩固进度条
primitives.signature: ({ x, y, w, stages, consolidation, color, progress })

primitives.name: IonTransit
primitives.summary: ionTransit(open, transit, direction) drives an ion across the entire membrane (−110 to +110 px for inward). Closed gate blocks transit; gap reflects opening.

primitives.name: ChemicalSynapse
primitives.summary: ligandState moves neurotransmitter from vesicle through cleft to receptors; binding requires release=1 and activates receptor ions; clearance removes ligands.

primitives.name: CircuitSignal
primitives.summary: circuitState/pointOnPath moves a signal along supplied anatomical relay path; only endpoint arrival activates final node.

primitives.name: SynapticWeight
primitives.summary: Explicit synaptic strength changes link thickness and actual EPSP response amplitude input*strength; receptor count changes visible receptor collection.

notes: 配色族 okabe-ito-dark：Okabe-Ito / Wong 2011（8 色安全集，去 #000000）
所有显示的数字必须由函数产出，不要在场景里写字面量

shared.note: L1c shared coordinates, layout and path movement; L3 owns teaching sequence.
